name: Windows Settings Manager Pro
description:
Windows Settings Manager Pro is the complete Windows Control Center for Stream Deck.

It takes the same everyday use case as Lite — control Windows without opening Settings or leaving what you are doing — and expands it into a full 15-key control surface.

Everything is centered around practical Windows controls: Lock, Sleep, Hibernate, protected Restart, protected Shutdown, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Power Plan, Keep Awake, Light/Dark theme, Previous Desktop, Next Desktop, New Desktop, Close Desktop, and Current Desktop.

Stateful keys re-read Windows. Wi-Fi and Bluetooth fail closed when hardware, policy, or permissions do not allow control. Power Plan shows the active plan. Keep Awake shows STAY AWAKE or SLEEP NORMAL. Theme shows LIGHT, DARK, or MIXED. Current Desktop shows the active desktop index and count when Windows exposes reliable state.

Restart and Shutdown require a second press within three seconds by default so one accidental tap does not end your session. Hibernate reports N/A when unavailable. Virtual desktop changes are followed by Windows state readback instead of being treated as successful just because a shortcut was sent.

Pro also keeps advanced HDR, display topology, screen/sleep timeout, System Status, and optional PC Mode actions available for power users. Monitor Manager remains PackRat's deeper display-management product.

No coordinate clicking, hidden mouse movement, or fake state. Includes editable profiles for Stream Deck, Stream Deck Mini, Stream Deck XL, Stream Deck +, Stream Deck Neo, Galleon 100 SD, and Stream Deck + XL.

Requires Windows and Stream Deck 7.3 or later. Individual controls depend on Windows hardware, policy, and capability availability.

Part of the PackRat ecosystem.
release_notes:
- Full 15-key Windows Control Center built on the same everyday Windows-control use case as Lite.
- Adds Hibernate, protected Restart and Shutdown, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Light/Dark theme, and full virtual desktop management.
- Live Windows state and fail-closed capability handling.
- Advanced HDR, topology, timeout, System Status, and optional PC Mode actions remain available.
- Editable profiles for seven current Stream Deck device families.
